_note: AGENT = Claude Code (Opus 5.5 via Bedrock) instead of Codex; same workload, goldens and judge as the Codex case. Kimi-K3 open-ended optimizer case: ONE MLA (dense full-attention) decoder layer of Kimi-K3 on sglang v0.5.20, B200, in the cookbook production shape (attention TP8 rank = 12 heads, cutedsl_mla decode backend with page 64 and fp8_e4m3 latent KV, EP8 rank = 112 mxfp4 routed experts). LARGE-BATCH variant (B=512/256 decode at 8k). Metric = CUDA-graph replay time of the decode step. No PR answer key: improvement over the pristine tree + correctness (output + written KV row vs a seeded golden with planted high-norm keys). Driver runs with --bf16-gemm-init (production scheduler's bf16 GEMM backend init: auto -> cutedsl TGV/split-K dispatch on SM100); the original decode cases keep the legacy cuBLAS-only dispatch (measured effect <= 0.7%).

render.METRIC: CUDA-graph decode-step latency of one Kimi-K3 MLA decoder layer
render.MODEL_NAME: Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): one MLA (dense multi-head latent attention) decoder layer, as it runs on one B200 of the production TP8/EP8 deployment (12 attention heads, cutedsl_mla decode over a paged fp8 latent KV, 112 local mxfp4 experts)
render.WORKLOAD: batched decode, one token per request per step: B=512 requests at context 8192 (primary: large-batch regime -- ~1024 local MoE rows, attention over 512 x 8k fp8 latent KV), plus B=256 at 8192 and a MIXED-length batch of B=16 with contexts 65,536 / 49,152 / 32,768 / 16,384 (must not regress)
render.REBUILD_CMD: find /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; cd /tmp && python3 /tmp/kimi_single_layer_decode.py --point 1,8192 --attn-type mla --moe-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --attention-backend cutedsl_mla --attn-heads 12 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --experts 112 --ep 8 --local-topk 2 --hidden-scale 1.0 --cuda-graph --iters 5 --warmup 2 --bf16-gemm-init && echo LAYER_SMOKE_OK
